meta.title: KEEP SEVEN
meta.voice: Narrator: past tense, third person, dry and counted; 4 to 14 words a sentence; one image a sentence; the worse the thing, the plainer the line. Station: calm procedure in wide capitals, never personality. The Dowser (notes only): unhurried, exact, never unkind.

station.style: wide tracked capitals; preceded by a three-note chime; tones, never speech

card.style: title card, centred; numeral and title

caption.style: small, bracketed; shown only when captions for sounds are on

rules.seconds: suggested hold. Narrator, Reeve, hint and station lines: 1.5 + 0.06 per character, rounded to 0.5, minimum 2. Deliberate exceptions: title cards carry their own durations (3.5 to 5); captions are fixed at 2; stn_boss_indexing is 1.5 (one index step); stn_proven, stn_dry and nar_last are held longer than the formula
rules.readable_cards: a blank line in a readable body starts a new card
rules.placeholders: {n} a number; {movement} a roman numeral; {forward} {left} {back} {right} {fire} {reload} {sprint} {interact} {line} {kept} the bound key names
rules.narrator_repeat: Every nar_* line plays at most once per run, whatever fires it and however many markers name it (the flag is saved with the checkpoint). hint_*, stn_* and cap_* lines may repeat. The once_only list names the lines whose single use is load-bearing or conditional.
rules.courtesy_cap: The call "Water to you" appears only in rd_note_lip and rd_note_stone. The reply "And shade" appears only in nar_last. Do not add uses. It is never shown as a stock greeting: not in UI, menus, loading text, store text or marketing.
rules.oath_cap: The oath appears only in rv_ask.
rules.never: No line comments on, or counts, the felled. No line uses a name, term or phrase from the blocklist in docs/research/art-tone.md 1.5.

nar_open_1.speaker: narrator
nar_open_1.text: Coffee in his pot, gone to tar. Two days, by the crust on it.

nar_open_2.speaker: narrator
nar_open_2.text: He had left the pot, and a note under a spent case.

nar_tin.speaker: narrator
nar_tin.text: A tin of cartridges, too. He kept her in lead. It was not kindness.

nar_seven.speaker: narrator
nar_seven.text: A Reeve keeps seven. Six for the work. One for the oath.

nar_rule.speaker: narrator
nar_rule.text: The Rule stood on the far edge of everything. It leaned.

nar_not_for_firing.speaker: narrator
nar_not_for_firing.text: Not that one. That one was for keeping.

nar_jugs_sand.speaker: narrator
nar_jugs_sand.text: Sand ran out of the first jug. Sand would run out of all of them.

nar_jugs_open.speaker: narrator
nar_jugs_open.text: One more than her gun held. He knew what it held.

hint_jugs_2.speaker: narrator
hint_jugs_2.text: Six jugs down. The sweep wanted seven.

hint_jugs_2_few.speaker: narrator
hint_jugs_2_few.text: The jugs were the weight on the bar. Clay breaks.

hint_jugs_3.speaker: narrator
hint_jugs_3.text: The seventh hung high, on the dead pylon's arm.

hint_jugs_4.speaker: narrator
hint_jugs_4.text: The rope gave before her patience did.

nar_plenty.speaker: narrator
nar_plenty.text: The town was called Plenty. Somebody had meant it.

nar_kneeler.speaker: narrator
nar_kneeler.text: Somebody knelt at the trough, scooping. The trough was dry.

nar_first_fell.speaker: narrator
nar_first_fell.text: It folded like a coat slipping off a peg.

nar_first_seat.speaker: narrator
nar_first_seat.text: The knot went. What was under it sat down, and breathed.

nar_street_after.speaker: narrator
nar_street_after.text: Eight of them. She had started with six in the gun.

nar_marks.speaker: narrator
nar_marks.text: Every door wore the well mark. Every mark was struck through, neatly.

nar_first_knot.speaker: narrator
nar_first_knot.text: Something violet had knotted on the latch, as it knots on anything left crooked.

hint_yard_knot.speaker: narrator
hint_yard_knot.text: A knot wants a round put through it.

stn_yard_wake.speaker: station
stn_yard_wake.text: LIFT STATION 4. SURFACE POWER: WIND. THANK YOU FOR YOUR PATIENCE.

nar_transit.speaker: narrator
nar_transit.text: It took a sighting on the yard bell. Then it took one on her.

nar_dowser_seen.speaker: narrator
nar_dowser_seen.text: On the far rim, a man with a forked rod, dark against the sky. Watching.

nar_dowser_shot.speaker: narrator
nar_dowser_shot.text: Too far. He would know to the pace how far.

nar_dowser_gone.speaker: narrator
nar_dowser_gone.text: When she looked again there was only rim.

nar_tally_1.speaker: narrator
nar_tally_1.text: Eleven at the table. Hooded. Hands flat on the boards.

nar_tally_2.speaker: narrator
nar_tally_2.text: They had hooded themselves. A courtesy, once daylight began to hurt.

nar_tally_3.speaker: narrator
nar_tally_3.text: Then they had shut the light out, and sat down to bide.

nar_tally_wall.speaker: narrator
nar_tally_wall.text: Every household's share, in chalk. Four days in a shaking hand. Then none.

nar_tally_chair.speaker: narrator
nar_tally_chair.text: A chair at the head, pulled out. Not one of theirs. He had sat with them.

nar_tally_chair_2.speaker: narrator
nar_tally_chair_2.text: He had not turned them on her. He had sat, and counted, and gone on.

nar_tally_hearth.speaker: narrator
nar_tally_hearth.text: His cup on their hearthstone, the dregs dried to a ring. She had gained a day.

nar_tally_cloth.speaker: narrator
nar_tally_cloth.text: The share-cloth hung in the light's way. Family marks, in paint.

nar_ask.speaker: narrator
nar_ask.text: Did he spoil the wells, or only reach them first? She meant to ask.

stn_tally_wake_2.speaker: station
stn_tally_wake_2.text: SURFACE STAFF: ELEVEN, SEATED. WATER BELOW STANDARD: FOUR DAYS.

hint_daylight_2.speaker: narrator
hint_daylight_2.text: The old works woke to daylight. The town had boarded it out.

hint_daylight_3.speaker: narrator
hint_daylight_3.text: The north shutter. Then whatever hung in its way.

hint_daylight_4.speaker: narrator
hint_daylight_4.text: The latch was old. It let go on its own.

nar_two_rise.speaker: narrator
nar_two_rise.text: The light came up through the floor. Two of them stood.

nar_nine.speaker: narrator
nar_nine.text: Nine kept their seats. She let them keep them.

nar_pegs_1.speaker: narrator
nar_pegs_1.text: Coats on pegs, all the way down. Hats. Boots, paired.

nar_pegs_2.speaker: narrator
nar_pegs_2.text: The low pegs were bare. The children had gone east in time.

nar_watcher_1.speaker: narrator
nar_watcher_1.text: One sat in the niche, apart from the rest. It turned its hood to watch her.

nar_watcher_2.speaker: narrator
nar_watcher_2.text: It did nothing else. She went by.

nar_plate_1.speaker: narrator
nar_plate_1.text: A cast plate. On it, a cartridge with a band about its waist.

nar_plate_2.speaker: narrator
nar_plate_2.text: She knew the shape. She had carried one eleven years.

nar_plate_3.speaker: narrator
nar_plate_3.text: DO NOT KEEP, it said. The Assize had kept every one.

nar_line_first.speaker: narrator
nar_line_first.text: One round, one line, and everything on it.

hint_line_2.speaker: narrator
hint_line_2.text: They healed alone. They wanted bursting together.

hint_line_3.speaker: narrator
hint_line_3.text: From the brass mark the knots sat one inside the other. One line would take all.

nar_file.speaker: narrator
nar_file.text: Six, in a queue, at the far door. They turned.

nar_file_lined.speaker: narrator
nar_file_lined.text: They sat down in order, like a thing being counted.

nar_file_behind.speaker: narrator
nar_file_behind.text: Two more on the stair behind her. They had waited to be last.

nar_file_more.speaker: narrator
nar_file_more.text: Four more, from the far door. These had not queued.

nar_tamper_1.speaker: narrator
nar_tamper_1.text: The Tamper had a job once. It was still doing it.

hint_tamper_vent.speaker: narrator
hint_tamper_vent.text: Lead rang off its plate. The vents stood open only after the blow.

nar_tamper_dead.speaker: narrator
nar_tamper_dead.text: It stopped mid-stroke. It had never been anyone. That helped.

nar_mark_1.speaker: narrator
nar_mark_1.text: The lift head, drawn on the wall. Six in a ring, and one hung apart.

nar_mark_2.speaker: narrator
nar_mark_2.text: The same mark was stamped under her loading gate.

nar_mark_3.speaker: narrator
nar_mark_3.text: It had never been a crest. It was a diagram of how the thing was used.

stn_lift_1.speaker: station
stn_lift_1.text: LIFT HEAD INVENTORY. CHAMBERS: SIX. IN SERVICE: SIX.

stn_lift_2.speaker: station
stn_lift_2.text: PROVING CHARGE: NOT IN CRADLE. BORE: UNPROVEN. LIFT WILL PROCEED.

nar_windlass_seen.speaker: narrator
nar_windlass_seen.text: It hung over the bore like her own cylinder, seen from the wrong end.

nar_embers_1.speaker: narrator
nar_embers_1.text: Embers, still orange. He had been here inside the hour.

nar_embers_2.speaker: narrator
nar_embers_2.text: It was the first warm light below ground, and it was his.

nar_cradle.speaker: narrator
nar_cradle.text: A cradle, cast for one banded round. Dust everywhere but there.

nar_cradle_2.speaker: narrator
nar_cradle_2.text: One thumbprint in the dust. He had taken it out and carried it off.

stn_ask_done.speaker: station
stn_ask_done.text: CRADLE: NONE. NOTED. BORE UNPROVEN. ENTER AND STAND CLEAR.

hint_ask_2.speaker: narrator
hint_ask_2.text: It asked for numbers. The walls were covered in numbers.

hint_ask_3.speaker: narrator
hint_ask_3.text: The cradle was empty. No port was marked for none. She did not fire.

hint_ask_3_num.speaker: narrator
hint_ask_3_num.text: The answer was cast on the wall beside the door.

hint_boss_haul.speaker: narrator
hint_boss_haul.text: The ribs stopped what it threw. Lit meant open. All six opened to haul.

stn_parley_1.speaker: station
stn_parley_1.text: LIFT HEAD PRESENTING. SIX CHAMBERS. STATE BUSINESS AT THE BORE.

nar_parley.speaker: narrator
nar_parley.text: A Reeve asks once before she draws. She asked.

rv_ask.speaker: reeve
rv_ask.text: By the Rule and the round: will you stand down?

stn_parley_2.speaker: station
stn_parley_2.text: CHAMBER ONE: STAKE. TWO: STAKE. THREE: CANISTER.

stn_parley_3.speaker: station
stn_parley_3.text: FOUR: STAKE. FIVE: STAKE. SIX: CANISTER.

stn_parley_4.speaker: station
stn_parley_4.text: WILL NOT STAND DOWN. A LIT CHAMBER IS OPEN. ALL SIX OPEN ON THE HAUL.

nar_parley_kept.speaker: narrator
nar_parley_kept.text: It stood open while she looked. It would open again to haul.

stn_boss_p1_break.speaker: station
stn_boss_p1_break.text: HEAD DAMAGED. GUARD WILL BE SET.

stn_boss_charge_required.speaker: station
stn_boss_charge_required.text: BORE UNPROVEN. PROVING CHARGE REQUIRED AT THE MARK.

stn_bore_line_short.speaker: station
stn_bore_line_short.text: LINE CHARGE. LINE SHORT. BORE DEPTH: 412.

nar_office.speaker: narrator
nar_office.text: A Reeve mends a well where she finds it broken. That was the whole office.

nar_one_left.speaker: narrator
nar_one_left.text: There was one proving charge left in Plenty. She was carrying it.

hint_kept_1.speaker: narrator
hint_kept_1.text: Lead would not finish it. She had carried the other round eleven years.

hint_kept_2.speaker: narrator
hint_kept_2.text: The brass mark at the kerb. The seventh round. Down the bore.

nar_seal.speaker: narrator
nar_seal.text: She broke the band with her thumb. It came away like wax. It was wax.

nar_kept.speaker: narrator
nar_kept.text: Eleven years kept. It took less than half a second to spend.

nar_hauling.speaker: narrator
nar_hauling.text: It went on hauling. There was nothing on the rope.

stn_service.speaker: station
stn_service.text: LIFT STATION 4 IN SERVICE. WATER WHERE YOU STAND.

nar_lift_up.speaker: narrator
nar_lift_up.text: The lift rose beside the line. She did not count the lamps.

nar_rim_1.speaker: narrator
nar_rim_1.text: Blue hour. She could not have said of which day.

nar_rim_2.speaker: narrator
nar_rim_2.text: A thread of light stood up out of Plenty, dead plumb.

nar_rim_3.speaker: narrator
nar_rim_3.text: Against it she could see how far the Rule leaned. Further than from the gully.

nar_lamps.speaker: narrator
nar_lamps.text: Lamps, down in Plenty. She counted them.

nar_lamps_count.speaker: narrator
nar_lamps_count.text: {n}, by her count. Somebody had found the matches.

nar_stone_1.speaker: narrator
nar_stone_1.text: Six spent cases on a flat stone, mouth up, in a row.

nar_stone_2.speaker: narrator
nar_stone_2.text: Kept rounds, all of them. Five she could have put a name to.

nar_stone_3.speaker: narrator
nar_stone_3.text: The sixth was older than the Assize.

nar_stone_4.speaker: narrator
nar_stone_4.text: And a seventh, unfired. The band on it was the wrong colour.

nar_take_1.speaker: narrator
nar_take_1.text: He had not taken hers. She had given it.

nar_take_2.speaker: narrator
nar_take_2.text: Seven again. It did not feel like keeping.

nar_leave.speaker: narrator
nar_leave.text: She left it on the stone. Six, then.

nar_fire.speaker: narrator
nar_fire.text: Out on the flat, one small fire. It was not moving.

nar_last.speaker: narrator
nar_last.text: "And shade," she said, to nobody, and went on.

cap_bider_rattle.speaker: caption
cap_bider_rattle.text: [a dry rattle, like wind in a sack]

rd_backstory.title: The story so far
rd_backstory.body:
The Assize was a court that rode. Its officers, the Reeves, carried a blued six-gun and seven rounds: six for the work, and one, banded, given at swearing and never fired.

The Assize judged water by the Rule, the bright upright on the horizon that every well was sunk true to. The court is gone. The Rule leans.

Tamsin Ware is the last Reeve anyone has heard of. For two years she has been behind the Dowser, who goes from well to well, and each one is wrong when she reaches it. He is never hurried. He always leaves her one more problem than her gun holds.

She does not know whether he spoils the wells or only reaches them first. She means to ask.

rd_note_lip.title: A note, weighted with a spent case
rd_note_lip.body:
Reeve Ware. Water to you.

You are two days behind and walking well. I have hung the gate below for you. Count what I hung.

You may call it rudeness. I call it arithmetic.
— D.

rd_rain_tally.title: A slate, in a child's hand
rd_rain_tally.body:
DAYS NO RAIN
A hundred strokes, bundled in fives, and a careful line ruled under them.

Under the line, in a grown hand: Wagon goes east at first light. Bring your slate.

rd_ledger.title: The water ledger of Plenty
rd_ledger.body:
Day 1. Water came up warm and the wrong colour. A man with a rod says it will clear. Shares drawn as usual.

Day 3. It is in the eyes now. Light hurts. Hoods for all who have it, so the rest need not look. Children sent east with the Hallam wagon. Shares drawn: half.

Day 4. Doors barred. Shutters. We will sit and bide till it clears. What else was there. Shares drawn: none.

rd_note_hearth.title: A note, on the hearthstone
rd_note_hearth.body:
Reeve. One day, now.

They did not suffer long. I sat with them and counted, so that somebody had.

You will want to go down. Your kind always does. Mind what you carry.
— D.

rd_plate_line.title: Cast plate: line charge
rd_plate_line.body:
PELLAM DEEPWORKS
LINE CHARGE. FOR SIGHTING.
ONE LINE THROUGH ALL IT MEETS.
STAND ON THE MARK. RETURN UNUSED CHARGES.

rd_plate_proving.title: Cast plate: proving charge
rd_plate_proving.body:
PELLAM DEEPWORKS
PROVING CHARGE. BANDED.
ONE ISSUED PER BORE.
FIRE ONLY DOWN THE BORE.
DO NOT KEEP.

rd_plate_service.title: Cast plate: tamping unit
rd_plate_service.body:
PELLAM DEEPWORKS
TAMPING UNIT. SERVICE INTERVAL: FORTY YEARS.
BUILT TO OUTLAST THE NEED.

rd_note_cradle.title: A note, under the empty cradle
rd_note_cradle.body:
Reeve. An hour, now, and you walking well.

The cradle is empty. I emptied it. There is one such charge left in Plenty, and I did not carry it in.

Mend the well or leave it crooked. I will think no less of you either way.
— D.

rd_note_stone.title: A note, under the first case
rd_note_stone.body:
For the one you spent. It is as true as the last, by my measure if not by yours.

Six came before you. Each mended a well. Look at the Rule, and ask what the mending cost.

I am not far, and I am not moving. Water to you, Reeve.
— D.

objectives.obj_lip_camp: His camp is two days cold. The gully runs down to a town. Go down.
objectives.obj_lip_gate: The stock gate is weighted shut. Lighten it.
objectives.obj_street: Front Street, Plenty. Walk it west.
objectives.obj_yard_door: The pump yard door is knotted shut.
objectives.obj_tally: The tally house. There is a way down, and no power to open it.
objectives.obj_tally_hatch: The hatch is lit. Its latch is knotted.
objectives.obj_gallery: The baffle door is held by three knots that mend each other.
objectives.obj_hall: Something is pounding in the lift hall. Get past it.
objectives.obj_lift: Take the lift down to the bore.
objectives.obj_ante: The bore door asks three questions.
objectives.obj_boss: The lift head will not stand down.
objectives.obj_boss_unproven: Lead will not hold it. The bore wants proving.
objectives.obj_boss_dry: The head is dry. Break its six chambers.

ui.ui_click_to_start: Click to take up the gun
ui.ui_credits_body: An original work. Every model, rig and scene authored in Blender. All sound synthesised as you play.
ui.ui_seventh_sealed: The kept round. Not for firing.
ui.ui_seventh_broken: The kept round. The band is broken.
ui.ui_death: She went down. The count began again.
ui.ui_hint_line: {line} to seat a line round under the hammer
ui.ui_opt_diff_easy_desc: They hit softer and come one at a time. The gun is the same.
ui.ui_opt_diff_normal_desc: As it was meant. The gun is the same.
ui.ui_opt_diff_hard_desc: They hit harder and come three at a time. The gun is the same.
